title: Add line checkbox to LyricsDisplay component
description: Add a checkbox on the left side of each lyric line that allows users to explicitly mark a line as learned. Checkbox should be visible while scrolling.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Checkbox rendered on left side of each lyric line
Checkbox visible in sticky/fixed position while scrolling
Checkbox toggles line learned state via mutation
Minimum 44x44px touch target for mobile accessibility
Verify in browser: checkboxes visible and clickable
